dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I'm the only one left from my team. I've decided not to go back.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...Miss Mochizuki, you know-it-all, how I wish you could witness the scenery of this unknown world...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...The things that you didn't know, the things that you were loath to believe, they are all here, shining...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry, Miss Mochizuki, I'm so sorry. I can't relate this to you in person...
